_doc: A buyer's choice of skin (the User 2026-10-31: "say a user buys one, how do THEY choose which Crissa to run that day?" and "Without a way to switch why would they buy any more?"; crissa-6a, MP store "a buyer's choice of skin"). Every number lib/crissa_skin_days.py and lib/crissa_skin_add.py use; none in code.

days.tick_why: how often the panel asks whether today's skin is on yet. A day starts once; a switch waits for her to be quiet, so 30 s is the longest it waits past the moment she falls quiet, and the read is three local GETs.
days.probe_why: each local busy read (the player's /v1/state, the ear's /health). A piece that refuses the connection is not running and holds nothing; one that answers late or with no busy keys is 'cannot tell' and the switch waits.

add.staged_why: a Store install downloads and checks the pack before it asks 'Install <name>?'; an answer never given leaves the staged copy, removed after this many hours (the store link itself still works for its own 7 days).
add.agent_keep_free_why: a whole agent pack (crissa-6a #7: PC + mobile/ + mobile/packs in one zip) is 1.5-2.1 GB and 7,710 files (Crissa, measured 2026-10-31), past the loop-pack door's 2 GiB / 5,000 files; so its size is checked against this disk's own free room instead: the zip and its unpacked folder must fit and leave this much free (the folder is then moved into libraries/, never copied).

changing.notice_why: how long after a pick the desk Wall's stale-feed corner says "Changing to <name>..." instead of FEED STALE: a player lane restart measured in seconds; past this a stale feed is a real fault again and says so.

offer.agents_why: the User 2026-10-31 for 1.0.5: "Crissa looks only for 1.0.5. V2 we can install the switcher. Everything works in store but for Bash so maybe we add a note that agent switcher to come in v2". A skin changes only her picture; her voice, name, wake word, krew profile and phone persona stay Crissa, so another agent's face would answer as Crissa. A library is offered when its agent (library.json `agent`, else its face) is listed here; a shipped face keeps the 10-28 list (crissa-default-skin.json `hidden`). CRISSA_SKIN_ALL_AGENTS=1 lifts it (v2).
offer.note: Other agents (Bash and more): the agent switcher comes in Crissa v2.
